snapshot.title: 26 November 2026 individual-personalization backlog refresh
snapshot.note: Current planning scope: two individual English-speaking researchers; six development handovers, 18 evaluation variants, optional reviewed voice, phones/computers and local-first continuity. Stable story/task IDs retain GitHub history. Engineering implementation and human acceptance are tracked separately.
snapshot.forecastNote: Sprint forecasts are reorderable planning aids, not new calendar commitments. Native GitHub milestones, their dates and existing assignments are preserved. Members self-select work against a single Sprint Goal. Deferred weight training, adapter activation, hardware and invention review are outside the current core study.
snapshot.documentNote: Preview selected course documents here or open them in Google Drive. Access follows each file's Google sharing settings. Earlier proposals are dated; the updated report and manual retain historical game appendices. Document files are not bundled with this website.

productGoal: Evaluate whether a frozen profile of an individual sender's approved examples helps the receiver interpret new smart-factory support handovers and choose the correct next action, compared with no AI and the same base AI. Preserve natural originals and separate later human clarification; support phones/computers with local-first checkpoints and optional encrypted continuity after owner setup.

Record queries, inclusion/exclusion decisions, citations and page/section evidence. Do not treat AI search summaries as verified sources.
Compare operational-meaning measures and participant/device designs; do not transfer group-dialect or ASR results to this two-person study without qualification.
tasks: Agree query families for industrial handover, individual personalization, clarification and offline deployment.
Retrieve primary papers and source records, deduplicate them, and save a reproducible search log.
Screen candidate sources and record exclusions and applicability to the current study.
Extract methods, datasets, participants, operational outcomes and limitations into the matrix.
Have another member verify a sample of claims and citations, then resolve discrepancies.
stories.deliverable: Verified literature matrix, search/exclusion log and a short synthesis linked to the current research question.
stories.risk: Synthetic examples and generic collaboration studies do not establish benefits in a real factory.

stories.title: Review approved sender memory and frozen profile isolation

Evaluation assignments embed immutable, hashed snapshots. Retrieval selects bounded historical examples from that sender; it never substitutes the receiver's memory or current private reference.

Review tests for tampering, role mismatch and evaluation leakage. Removing an example from a later working profile does not silently rewrite an existing evaluation snapshot; consent withdrawal needs a recorded study-data decision.

stories.deliverable: Approved profile cards, immutable snapshot/prompt traces and a reviewed memory/withdrawal boundary.
stories.risk: Retrieval can propagate a mistaken historical meaning. This is example-memory personalization, not changed model weights.
stories.evidence: Implementation review links: INDIVIDUAL_STUDY.md, PWA.md, CONTINUITY_SETUP.md and relevant tests. Participant/physical acceptance remains pending.

Keep only work that can finish this sprint.

checklists.title: Definition of Done
items: All acceptance criteria have linked evidence.

Integrated increment works; documents and board are updated.
